# Zhangjiajie Guide — Full Content Map
> Independent travel guide to Zhangjiajie National Park. 20+ visits of firsthand experience. No booking fees. Last updated: August 2026.

## Core Pages

### [Homepage](https://zhangjiajie-national-park.com/)
The central planning hub. Covers: hero summary, quick facts, What is Zhangjiajie National Park, park map (5 zones + cable cars + shuttle routes), local favorites by persona, 20-visit timeline (2015-2026), trip planner, when to go, your first day, wildlife, why visit, 1/3/5 day itinerary cards, checklist, FAQ, recently updated, author E-E-A-T.

### [Complete Guide](https://zhangjiajie-national-park.com/guide/)
Everything in one place: park zones, how to get there (flights, trains, buses), tickets, transport inside the park, hiking trails, where to stay, food, weather, 3-day classic itinerary.

### [Tickets & Prices](https://zhangjiajie-national-park.com/tickets/)
Forest Park entry: ¥225 peak (Mar-Nov), ¥115 off-peak (Dec-Feb). Tianmen Mountain: ¥258. Glass Bridge: ¥138. Fenghuang: ¥128 for core area. 7 in-park transport prices. 4 buying options compared. 5 money-saving tips with savings amounts.

## Planning

### [1, 3 & 5 Day Itineraries](https://zhangjiajie-national-park.com/itinerary/)
Field-tested plans: 1-day express (¥500), classic 3-day (¥1,200), in-depth 5-day (¥2,000). Each with timing, budget, and personal recommendations.

### [Where to Stay](https://zhangjiajie-national-park.com/hotels/)
21 hotels across 3 areas: 12 in Wulingyuan (luxury to budget), 6 in city center, 3 inside the park. Price ranges, highlights, best-for labels. Tier system: Luxury/Boutique/Mid-range/Budget/Rustic. Quick comparison table. 5 booking tips.

### [Weather & Climate](https://zhangjiajie-national-park.com/weather/)
12-month temperature, rainfall, what to wear. Seasonal advice. How weather affects visibility and park access. Based on visits across all seasons.

### [Food Guide](https://zhangjiajie-national-park.com/food/)
Tujia specialties: smoked pork, sanxiaguo hot pot, wild mushrooms, sour fish soup, sticky rice cakes, pickled vegetables. Best restaurants in Wulingyuan and downtown.

## Explore

### [Tianmen Mountain](https://zhangjiajie-national-park.com/tianmen-mountain/)
World's longest cable car (7.5km). Heaven's Gate natural arch (131.5m high). Glass skywalks on cliff face. 99-Bend Road (Tongtian Avenue). Buddhist temple at summit.

### [Avatar Hallelujah Mountain](https://zhangjiajie-national-park.com/avatar-mountains/)
The real-life inspiration for Pandora's floating mountains. Film connection (2008-2010). 5 Yuanjiajie viewpoints. 4-step best route. Photography tips. FAQ.

### [Zhangjiajie Glass Bridge](https://zhangjiajie-national-park.com/glass-bridge/)
430m glass-bottom bridge, 300m above canyon. Bungee jump (260m, world's highest). Zipline, via ferrata, glass slide. Canyon descent options. Verdict: who should go and who should skip.

### [Hiking Trails](https://zhangjiajie-national-park.com/hiking-trails/)
6 trails with difficulty color-coding: Golden Whip Stream (Easy), Ten-mile Gallery (Easy), Huangshi Village (Moderate), Yuanjiajie (Moderate), Tianzi Mountain (Moderate-Hard), Yangjiajie (Hard). Access, timing, tips per trail. Trail picker recommendations. Safety tips. 8-item packing list.

### [Photography Guide](https://zhangjiajie-national-park.com/photography/)
7 best photo spots with camera settings and gear recommendations. 4 seasonal notes. 6 essential gear items. Drone policy. Phone photography tips.

### [Fenghuang Ancient Town](https://zhangjiajie-national-park.com/fenghuang-ancient-town/)
Day trip from Zhangjiajie: bus schedules, ticket prices, what to see, when to go, where to eat, riverside hotel options. Honest assessment of commercialism vs charm.

### [Zhangjiajie vs Huangshan vs Guilin](https://zhangjiajie-national-park.com/compare/)
Honest comparison of China's three iconic mountain landscapes: sandstone pillars vs granite peaks vs karst cones. Best for: photography, hiking, accessibility.
